provenance.curation: Agent-curated synthetic heldout robustness queries from checked-in seed content; not human-user or production-traffic labels.
provenance.chunkIdSemantics: Relevant IDs are the original documents[].chunks[].id values in the country JSON seeds. Runtime visa_chunks rows currently have generated UUIDs, so this set is a source-level gold set.
provenance.evidenceSemantics: Every positive evidence.text value is copied verbatim from the referenced seed chunk content and is limited to one or two complete sentences. Multi-intent positives include each required source chunk.
provenance.negativePolicy: An unanswerable case retains a non-empty candidate pool through its country/documentType filters, but the checked-in seeds do not contain the exact requested live, numeric, or unrelated information. Negative entries have empty relevantChunkIds and evidence.
provenance.selectionPolicy: All 20 queries are heldout robustness cases and must not be used for parameter selection. Every positive parent-country tuple is absent from the positive labels in rag-retrieval-queries.json and rag-retrieval-confirmation-queries.json. The cross-country template parents official_field_answer_norms and standard_passport_identity_field_rules are excluded.
provenance.runtimeFilterNote: Visa types use source product codes or the runtime alias EU_SCHENGEN_C_SHORT_STAY, which normalizes to schengen_short_stay_tourism. Explicit country and documentTypes filters keep the positive and negative candidate pools scoped to supported service countries.
